properties.description: G26 rewrite of P26_LoadOptions (both G26 cases).

activities.name: Load with SSIS fast-load semantics
activities.description: INSERT ... SELECT instead of Copy, so the trigger fires and the column default applies.

scripts.text:
-- A Copy activity bulk insert never checks constraints or fires triggers, so this load is a plain INSERT:
-- the trigger fires (FIRE_TRIGGERS), rows the CHECK constraint would reject are filtered out (the SSIS
-- error output dropped them), and a NULL Channel takes the column default (KEEPNULLS off).
INSERT out_adf.G26_LoadOptions (SourceId, Amount, Channel)
SELECT SourceId, Amount, Channel FROM pty.G26_Input WHERE Amount > 0 AND Channel IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SourceId;
INSERT out_adf.G26_LoadOptions (SourceId, Amount)
SELECT SourceId, Amount FROM pty.G26_Input WHERE Amount > 0 AND Channel IS NULL ORDER BY SourceId;
